notes: Trained once on 4 independent normal-operation telemetry sessions (336 rows pooled), each from a freshly started application instance -- NOT retrained per experiment run.
No fault labels exist for this telemetry; threshold is NOT F1-tuned (unlike the offline datasets).
Superseded the original per-run warmup design after it was found to be unreliable (see results/reports/limitations_report.md item 8).
